author_position.description: Place in the complete author list of the work, never in the in-region shortlist; it decides the authorship role.

signal_type.description: Open vocabulary; erc_, dfg_, snsf_, fwf_, swecris_, rcn_, dff_, fris_ and aei_ funding signals require role pi. Optional national_project/national_fellowship signals require evidence for role pi and do not trigger funding-role inference. resource_allocation records compute/in-kind support and is excluded from research-grant aggregation and funding-role inference. Membership signals use graduiertenkolleg_member or imprs_member.

parent.description: name_raw of the signal this was hopped from

note.description: caveat about this signal (affiliation at award time, alumni list, image-only source...)

fit.description: core = the work is the domain itself; adjacent = general robotics / neighbouring field (broad RoboCup leagues, exoskeletons, electronics-side PE7)

homepage.description: public lab or personal page naming the person, when the source gives one

role_title.description: Verbatim title or section heading associated with this name on the source page.

topics.description: 1–3 phrases copied verbatim from a paper title, project name or repository name.
